Pusheen Sitting with Floating Hearts and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits with floating hearts and stars in this printable coloring page. The smiling cat has three forehead stripes, two rounded side markings, small front paws, and a curled striped tail, with large heart and star outlines surrounding its rounded body in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sleeping on a Cushion Beside a Bedroom Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen sleeping on a cushion beside a bedroom window. Closed eyes and tucked front paws rest above the round padded bed, while a crescent moon, stars, tied-back curtains, and a lamp on a small bedside table complete this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Playing with a Ball of Yarn on a Rug Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen plays with a ball of yarn on a rug in this printable coloring page. One front paw rests on the wound yarn as a loose strand trails over the fringed rug, with a heart-patterned cushion and broad-leafed potted plant behind the cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Reading a Book Under a Cozy Blanket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen reading a book under a cozy blanket. Hearts decorate the blanket draped over the cat's head and the open book's cover, while two large pillows and a steaming heart-decorated mug complete the quiet reading scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Using a Laptop at a Low Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen uses a laptop at a low desk in this printable coloring page. The cat's front paws rest near the keyboard while it sits on a padded floor cushion, with a cat-face mug and a small potted succulent beside the computer in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Hugging a Teddy Bear on Her Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen hugging a teddy bear on her bed. The bear has a large tied bow and rounded paws, while a curved headboard, frilled pillow, heart-shaped cushion, and scalloped blanket edge decorate the bedroom setting in this cuddly coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Listening to Music Through Headphones Beside a Music Player Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen listens to music through headphones beside a music player in this printable coloring page. A cable connects the large ear cups to a rectangular player with a circular control, while floating musical notes, hearts, and a potted plant surround the cushioned cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Playing a Small Acoustic Guitar Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen playing a small acoustic guitar while sitting on a cushion. One paw rests above the round sound hole and the other holds the neck, with strings, tuning pegs, and the curved instrument body outlined across this music-themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Dj at Turntables Beneath a Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen works as a DJ at turntables beneath a disco ball in this printable coloring page. The headphone-wearing cat places its paws on two records beside mixer sliders and knobs, while sparkle shapes and rays surround the tiled hanging ball in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Taking a Bubble Bath with a Rubber Duck Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen taking a bubble bath with a rubber duck. Suds sit on the cat's head and overflow the claw-foot tub, while floating bubbles, a towel draped over the rim, and small puddles complete the bath-time scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating a Slice of Pizza at a Picnic Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen eats a slice of pizza at a picnic table in this printable coloring page. The cat holds a partly eaten slice while sitting on a wooden bench, with an open pizza box on the tabletop and rounded bushes and grass behind this outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Licking an Ice Cream Cone Beside an Ice Cream Cart Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen licking an ice cream cone beside an ice cream cart. Sprinkles cover the scoop above a waffle-patterned cone, while the cart displays extra ice cream, stacked cones, and a topping jar beneath a paneled awning in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Holding a Frosted Donut Outside a Bakery Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen holds a frosted donut outside a bakery in this printable coloring page. The sprinkled treat matches the shop's large donut sign, while cupcakes and donuts fill the window beside a striped awning, flowerpots, pavement stones, and a tall streetlamp in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Drinking Boba Tea Through a Straw at a Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen drinking boba tea through a straw at a cafe. The pearl-filled cup sits between a cherry-topped cupcake and flower vase on a round table, with an arched window, hanging lamp, and potted plant behind the cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating Sushi Rolls at a Low Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen eats sushi rolls at a low table in this printable coloring page. Chopsticks lift one roll above a raised serving board holding four more, while a striped cup, small dipping bowl, and side plate sit near the cat's tasseled floor cushion in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Enjoying a Burger and Fries at a Diner Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen enjoying a burger and fries at a diner counter. The cat holds a sesame-topped burger while seated on a round stool, with fries, a lidded drink, napkin dispenser, and squeeze bottle beneath two hanging lamps in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Slurping Ramen Noodles From a Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen slurps ramen noodles from a bowl in this printable coloring page. Long wavy noodles stretch toward its mouth above an egg half and spiral-centered topping, while chopsticks and a scalloped bowl pattern add details to the low-table scene in this food coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating Steamed Dumplings from a Bamboo Steamer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen eating steamed dumplings from a bamboo steamer. Chopsticks hold one pleated dumpling above three more with rising steam, while a small dipping bowl, leafy plant, and low wooden table surround the seated cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Enjoying Pumpkin Pie at a Thanksgiving Dinner Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen enjoys pumpkin pie at a Thanksgiving dinner in this printable coloring page. The cat holds a plated slice topped with whipped cream, while a partly cut pie, pumpkins, autumn leaves, an acorn, and a flower-filled pitcher decorate the table in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Holding a Taco Beside a Bowl of Salsa Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen holding a taco beside a bowl of salsa. Leafy filling and thin topping strips peek above the folded shell, while three triangular tortilla chips and a wavy decoration around the salsa bowl complete the checked-placemat scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Chef Hat and Mixing Cupcake Batter Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a chef hat and mixes cupcake batter in this printable coloring page. A spoon stirs the heart-decorated bowl beside a flour bag, measuring jug, eggs, and a small ingredient bowl, with four empty cupcake liners in a baking pan on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Baking Cookies with a Rolling Pin and Cookie Cutters Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen baking cookies with a rolling pin and cookie cutters. Star and heart shapes are cut into the dough beneath the cat's paws, while matching cutters, a baking tray, a mixing bowl, and a lidded jar fill this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sniffing Flowers in a Spring Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sniffs flowers in a spring garden in this printable coloring page. The cat leans toward a cluster of tall tulips amid smaller blossoms, while a butterfly with a looping dotted trail, flowering bushes, a picket fence, and clouds complete this garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Roller Skating Along a Smooth Park Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen roller skating along a smooth park path. The cat balances on wheeled skates with its front paws lifted, passing a slatted bench and tall streetlamp among flowering bushes, grass, a leafy tree, and clouds in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Ice Skating on a Frozen Pond in a Winter Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen ice skates on a frozen pond in a winter scarf in this printable coloring page. The long striped scarf has a fringed end, and one skate lifts behind the cat above curved ice marks, with snowy banks and pine trees completing this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Riding a Surfboard on a Gentle Ocean Wave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen riding a surfboard on a gentle ocean wave. The cat balances on all four paws along the striped board, with a raised tail, splashing droplets, a foamy wave crest, and a large sun above the water in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Relaxing on a Donut Pool Float Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen relaxes on a donut pool float in this printable coloring page. Both front paws rest on the sprinkled inflatable ring as the cat's striped tail rises behind it, while small water ripples, a bright sun outline, and rounded clouds complete this summer coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing Sunglasses on a Beach Towel Under an Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen wearing sunglasses on a beach towel under an umbrella. The reclining cat rests on a striped towel beside a starfish and two shells, with pebbles, small ocean waves, and a sun filling the seaside setting in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Riding in a Hot Air Balloon Basket Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen rides in a hot air balloon basket above the clouds in this printable coloring page. Twisted ropes connect the woven basket to a large paneled balloon with scalloped trim, while the cat's front paws rest on the rim between scattered clouds in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Looking Through a Rocket Ship Window at Stars and Planets Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen looking through a rocket ship window at stars and planets. The round porthole has a dotted rim, with rocket fins and flames below the cat, while a ringed planet, a patterned planet, and a cratered moon surround this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Unicorn Walking Across a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen appears as a unicorn walking across a rainbow in this printable coloring page. A striped horn, flowing mane, and long sweeping tail transform the cat, while one front paw lifts above the rainbow arches amid clouds, stars, and sparkles in this fantasy coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Mermaid Swimming Among Fish and Coral Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen as a mermaid swimming among fish and coral. Overlapping scales cover the long tail beneath the cat's front paws, while four fish, floating bubbles, seaweed, rocks, and a scalloped shell surround the split tail fin in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Dinosaur Beside a Volcano and Prehistoric Ferns Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen appears as a dinosaur beside a volcano and prehistoric ferns in this printable coloring page. Triangular spikes run from the cat's head along its curved tail, while lava and a rising plume emerge from the volcano above rocks and leafy plants in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Fairy Resting on a Mushroom Among Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen as a fairy resting on a mushroom among flowers. Large butterfly-like wings with circular markings spread behind the seated cat, while spots cover the mushroom cap above three tall blossoms, leafy stems, and grassy tufts in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Birthday Hat Beside a Cake with Candles Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a birthday hat beside a cake with candles in this printable coloring page. Three striped candles burn above the sprinkled layer cake, while a pom-pom tops the cat's matching striped party hat and floating hearts surround the celebration in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Witch Hat and Stirring a Halloween Cauldron Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen wearing a witch hat and stirring a Halloween cauldron. Stars decorate the buckled hat above a bow-tied cape, while bubbles rise from the handled pot among pumpkins, curling vines, floating stars, and a crescent moon in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Ghost Costume Beside a Haunted House Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a ghost costume beside a haunted house in this printable coloring page. A draped sheet hangs above the cat's visible paws, while pumpkins, bare trees, a winding stepping-stone path, and a tall house with pointed roofs fill the moonlit scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Pumpkin Costume with a Halloween Candy Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen wearing a pumpkin costume with a Halloween candy basket. Jack-o'-lantern faces decorate both the rounded outfit and matching bucket, which holds wrapped sweets and a spiral lollipop, while a stemmed cap sits between the cat's ears in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Santa Hat Beside Christmas Gifts and a Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a Santa hat beside Christmas gifts and a stocking in this printable coloring page. Large bows top three patterned presents around the cat, while a fluffy-cuffed stocking with a snowflake design rests beside a star-topped tree decorated with baubles in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Decorating the Lowest Branches of a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen decorating the lowest branches of a Christmas tree. The cat lifts a striped bauble toward a branch beside garlands, a bow, and heart and star ornaments, with a large topper above the tree's heart-patterned pot in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Decorating a Gingerbread House with Candy Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen decorates a gingerbread house with candy in this printable coloring page. A piping bag adds icing along the roof above round and heart-shaped decorations, while bowls of small sweets, outlined windows, and an arched door surround the tabletop house in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing Bunny Ears and Finding Easter Eggs in a Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen wearing bunny ears and finding Easter eggs in a garden. The cat reaches toward a flower-patterned egg beside a bow-tied woven basket, while tulips, butterflies, a picket fence, and more decorated eggs fill this springtime coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Holding a Heart-shaped Valentine Beside a Sealed Envelope Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen holds a heart-shaped Valentine beside a sealed envelope in this printable coloring page. Both front paws grip the large heart in front of the smiling cat, while a heart seal closes the envelope and three smaller hearts float above this Valentine's Day coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Celebrating New Year's Eve Beneath Confetti and a Clock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen celebrating New Year's Eve beneath confetti and a clock. A striped party hat tops the cat as it holds a sparkling wand, surrounded by curled streamers, stars, a bow-tied gift, and a clock with hands near midnight in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Playing in a Pile of Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen plays in a pile of autumn leaves in this printable coloring page. The cat lifts both front paws above overlapping maple-like and oak-like leaf outlines, while three loose leaves drift overhead with short motion marks beside the smiling face and raised tail in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Sharing Popcorn in Front of a Television Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen and Stormy sharing popcorn in front of a television. Each cat holds a piece above the striped serving bowl, with heart and star cushions, a draped blanket, and a trailing plant on the television stand completing this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Pip Splashing in a Shallow Backyard Paddling Pool Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Pip splash in a shallow backyard paddling pool in this printable coloring page. Water droplets rise around both cats as they lift their front paws, while heart and cat-face motifs decorate the inflatable pool beside flowering bushes and a picket fence in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Collecting Fallen Apples in an Orchard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen and Stormy collecting fallen apples in an orchard. Both cats reach toward fruit beside a woven basket already holding apples, while a large leafy apple tree, scattered leaves, and grassy tufts frame the harvest scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Building a Snowman in a Snowy Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Stormy build a snowman in a snowy garden in this printable coloring page. Pusheen adjusts the scarf around the carrot-nosed figure while Stormy rests a paw on a snowball, with snow-covered bushes, fence boards, and bare branches behind this winter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing an Astronaut Suit and Exploring the Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen wearing an astronaut suit and exploring the moon. A round helmet, chest controls, backpack, and ribbed hose equip the cat, while booted paws stand among lunar craters and rocks beneath stars and a view of Earth in this coloring sheet.

Pusheen in Sunflower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits in a sunflower field in this printable coloring page. Four large sunflower heads with broad circular centers rise around the smiling cat, their pointed petals and leafy stems outlined beneath a small sun above the distant hedge in this summer garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen in Camping Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen in a camping area holding a marshmallow on a stick. The cat sits at an open tent beside a small log fire, with a moon-and-star mat, evergreen trees, rocks, and a crescent moon completing this nighttime camping coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen By the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen rests by the fireplace in this printable coloring page. Flames rise above logs behind a simple metal guard, while a stocking hangs from the brick mantel beneath a round mirror, with a paw-print mat and striped fringed rug near the cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen in Cloud Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen in a cloud kingdom raising one front paw. A scalloped cloud arch frames the smiling cat on a cloud platform decorated with hearts, crescent moons, and stars, while more clouds and sparkles fill the sky in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen in Apple Orchard Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits in an apple orchard in this printable coloring page. Two fruit-laden trees frame the smiling cat beneath rounded clouds, while fallen leaves scatter around its curled striped tail and a single apple rests on the ground nearby in this autumn-themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen in Craft Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen in a craft room holding scissors and a ball of yarn. A knitting needle rests through the yarn, while buttons, a thread spool, a flower embroidery hoop, a brush jar, and shelves of supplies surround the worktable in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen on Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen stands on a mountain trail in this printable coloring page wearing a small hiking hat. The cat carries a backpack and grips a branch-shaped walking stick beside a winding rocky path, with distant peaks, evergreen trees, and a partly clouded sun completing this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen By the Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen sitting by the window with closed, smiling eyes. A striped tail curls over the wooden sill beside a potted flower, while tied-back curtains frame a view of a leafy tree, a cloud, and the sun in this coloring sheet.
